verses.original: Καὶ ἐν τῷ συμπληροῦσθαι τὴν ἡμέραν τῆς Πεντηκοστῆς ἦσαν πάντες ὁμοῦ ἐπὶ τὸ αὐτό
verses.transliteration: Kai en tō symplērousthai tēn hēmeran tēs Pentēkostēs ēsan pantes homou epi to auto
verses.literal: When the day of Pentecost came they were all together in one place
verses.literalPt: E, CUMPRINDO-SE o dia de Pentecostes, estavam todos concordemente no mesmo lugar;

verses.original: καὶ ἐγένετο ἄφνω ἐκ τοῦ οὐρανοῦ ἦχος ὥσπερ φερομένης πνοῆς βιαίας καὶ ἐπλήρωσεν ὅλον τὸν οἶκον οὗ ἦσαν καθήμενοι
verses.transliteration: kai egeneto aphnō ek tou ouranou ēchos hōsper pheromenēs pnoēs biaias kai eplērōsen holon ton oikon hou ēsan kathēmenoi
verses.literal: Suddenly a sound like a mighty rushing wind came from heaven and filled the whole house where they were sitting
verses.literalPt: E de repente veio do céu um som, como de um vento veemente e impetuoso, e encheu toda a casa em que estavam assentados.

verses.original: καὶ ὤφθησαν αὐτοῖς διαμεριζόμεναι γλῶσσαι ὡσεὶ πυρός καὶ ἐκάθισεν ἐφ’ ἕνα ἕκαστον αὐτῶν
verses.transliteration: kai ōphthēsan autois diamerizomenai glōssai hōsei pyros kai ekathisen eph’ hena hekaston autōn
verses.literal: They saw tongues like flames of fire that separated and came to rest on each . . . of them
verses.literalPt: E foram vistas por eles línguas repartidas, como que de fogo, as quais pousaram sobre cada um deles.

verses.original: καὶ ἐπλήσθησαν πάντες Πνεύματος Ἁγίου καὶ ἤρξαντο λαλεῖν ἑτέραις γλώσσαις καθὼς τὸ Πνεῦμα ἐδίδου ἀποφθέγγεσθαι αὐτοῖς
verses.transliteration: kai eplēsthēsan pantes Pneumatos Hagiou kai ērxanto lalein heterais glōssais kathōs to Pneuma edidou apophthengesthai autois
verses.literal: And they were all filled with the Holy Spirit and began to speak in other tongues as the Spirit enabled . . . them
verses.literalPt: E todos foram cheios do Espírito Santo, e começaram a falar noutras línguas, conforme o Espírito Santo lhes concedia que falassem.

verses.original: Ἦσαν δὲ εἰς Ἰερουσαλὴμ κατοικοῦντες Ἰουδαῖοι ἄνδρες εὐλαβεῖς ἀπὸ παντὸς ἔθνους τῶν ὑπὸ τὸν οὐρανόν
verses.transliteration: Ēsan de eis Ierousalēm katoikountes Ioudaioi andres eulabeis apo pantos ethnous tōn hypo ton ouranon
verses.literal: Now there were dwelling in Jerusalem God-fearing Jews . . . from every nation under heaven
verses.literalPt: E em Jerusalém estavam habitando judeus, homens religiosos, de todas as nações que estão debaixo do céu.

verses.original: γενομένης δὲ τῆς φωνῆς ταύτης συνῆλθεν τὸ πλῆθος καὶ συνεχύθη ὅτι ἤκουον εἷς ἕκαστος τῇ ἰδίᾳ διαλέκτῳ λαλούντων αὐτῶν
verses.transliteration: genomenēs de tēs phōnēs tautēs synēlthen to plēthos kai synechythē hoti ēkouon heis hekastos tē idia dialektō lalountōn autōn
verses.literal: And when this sound rang out a crowd came together in bewilderment because each one heard them speaking his own language
verses.literalPt: E, quando aquele som ocorreu, ajuntou-se uma multidão, e estava confusa, porque cada um os ouvia falar na sua própria língua.

verses.original: Ἐξίσταντο δὲ καὶ ἐθαύμαζον λέγοντες Οὐχ ἰδοὺ πάντες οὗτοί εἰσιν οἱ λαλοῦντες Γαλιλαῖοι
verses.transliteration: Existanto de kai ethaumazon legontes Ouch idou pantes houtoi eisin hoi lalountes Galilaioi
verses.literal: Astounded and amazed they asked Are not all these who are speaking Galileans
verses.literalPt: E todos pasmavam e se maravilhavam, dizendo uns aos outros: Pois quê! não são galileus todos esses homens que estão falando?

verses.original: καὶ πῶς ἡμεῖς ἀκούομεν ἕκαστος τῇ ἰδίᾳ διαλέκτῳ ἡμῶν ἐν ᾗ ἐγεννήθημεν
verses.transliteration: kai pōs hēmeis akouomen hekastos tē idia dialektō hēmōn en hē egennēthēmen
verses.literal: How is it then that each of us hears them in - his own native language
verses.literalPt: Como, pois, os ouvimos, cada um, na nossa própria língua em que somos nascidos?

verses.original: Πάρθοι καὶ Μῆδοι καὶ Ἐλαμῖται καὶ οἱ κατοικοῦντες τὴν Μεσοποταμίαν Ἰουδαίαν τε καὶ Καππαδοκίαν Πόντον καὶ τὴν Ἀσίαν
verses.transliteration: Parthoi kai Mēdoi kai Elamitai kai hoi katoikountes tēn Mesopotamian Ioudaian te kai Kappadokian Ponton kai tēn Asian
verses.literal: Parthians Medes and Elamites residents of Mesopotamia Judea and Cappadocia Pontus and Asia
verses.literalPt: Partos e medos, elamitas e os que habitam na Mesopotâmia, Judéia, Capadócia, Ponto e Ásia,

verses.original: Φρυγίαν τε καὶ Παμφυλίαν Αἴγυπτον καὶ τὰ μέρη τῆς Λιβύης τῆς κατὰ Κυρήνην καὶ οἱ ἐπιδημοῦντες Ῥωμαῖοι
verses.transliteration: Phrygian te kai Pamphylian Aigypton kai ta merē tēs Libyēs tēs kata Kyrēnēn kai hoi epidēmountes Rhōmaioi
verses.literal: Phrygia and Pamphylia Egypt and the parts of Libya near Cyrene - visitors from Rome
verses.literalPt: E Frígia e Panfília, Egito e partes da Líbia, junto a Cirene, e forasteiros romanos, tanto judeus como prosélitos,

verses.original: Ἰουδαῖοί τε καὶ προσήλυτοι Κρῆτες καὶ Ἄραβες ἀκούομεν λαλούντων αὐτῶν ταῖς ἡμετέραις γλώσσαις τὰ μεγαλεῖα τοῦ Θεοῦ
verses.transliteration: Ioudaioi te kai prosēlytoi Krētes kai Arabes akouomen lalountōn autōn tais hēmeterais glōssais ta megaleia tou Theou
verses.literal: both Jews and converts to Judaism Cretans and Arabs we hear them declaring the wonders of God in our own tongues
verses.literalPt: Cretenses e árabes, todos nós temos ouvido em nossas próprias línguas falar das grandezas de Deus.

verses.original: Ἐξίσταντο δὲ πάντες καὶ διηπόρουν ἄλλος πρὸς ἄλλον λέγοντες Τί θέλει τοῦτο εἶναι
verses.transliteration: Existanto de pantes kai diēporoun allos pros allon legontes Ti thelei touto einai
verses.literal: Astounded - and perplexed they asked one another . . . What does this mean
verses.literalPt: E todos se maravilhavam e estavam suspensos, dizendo uns para os outros: Que quer isto dizer?

verses.original: Ἕτεροι δὲ διαχλευάζοντες ἔλεγον ὅτι Γλεύκους μεμεστωμένοι εἰσίν
verses.transliteration: Heteroi de diachleuazontes elegon hoti Gleukous memestōmenoi eisin
verses.literal: But others mocked them and said They are drunk on new wine
verses.literalPt: E outros, zombando, diziam: Estão cheios de mosto.

verses.original: Σταθεὶς δὲ ὁ Πέτρος σὺν τοῖς ἕνδεκα ἐπῆρεν τὴν φωνὴν αὐτοῦ καὶ ἀπεφθέγξατο αὐτοῖς Ἄνδρες Ἰουδαῖοι καὶ οἱ κατοικοῦντες Ἰερουσαλὴμ πάντες τοῦτο ὑμῖν γνωστὸν ἔστω καὶ ἐνωτίσασθε τὰ ῥήματά μου
verses.transliteration: Statheis de ho Petros syn tois hendeka epēren tēn phōnēn autou kai apephthenxato autois Andres Ioudaioi kai hoi katoikountes Ierousalēm pantes touto hymin gnōston estō kai enōtisasthe ta rhēmata mou
verses.literal: Then Peter stood up with the Eleven lifted up his voice and addressed the crowd Men of Judea and all who dwell in Jerusalem let this be known to you and listen carefully to my words
verses.literalPt: Pedro, porém, pondo-se em pé com os onze, levantou a sua voz, e disse-lhes: Homens judeus, e todos os que habitais em Jerusalém, seja-vos isto notório, e escutai as minhas palavras.

verses.original: οὐ γὰρ ὡς ὑμεῖς ὑπολαμβάνετε οὗτοι μεθύουσιν ἔστιν γὰρ ὥρα τρίτη τῆς ἡμέρας
verses.transliteration: ou gar hōs hymeis hypolambanete houtoi methyousin estin gar hōra tritē tēs hēmeras
verses.literal: These men are not drunk as you suppose It is only the third hour of the day
verses.literalPt: Estes homens não estão embriagados, como vós pensais, sendo a terceira hora do dia.

verses.original: ἀλλὰ τοῦτό ἐστιν τὸ εἰρημένον διὰ τοῦ προφήτου Ἰωήλ
verses.transliteration: alla touto estin to eirēmenon dia tou prophētou Iōēl
verses.literal: No this is what was spoken by the prophet Joel
verses.literalPt: Mas isto é o que foi dito pelo profeta Joel:

verses.original: Καὶ ἔσται ἐν ταῖς ἐσχάταις ἡμέραις λέγει ὁ Θεός ἐκχεῶ ἀπὸ τοῦ Πνεύματός μου ἐπὶ πᾶσαν σάρκα καὶ προφητεύσουσιν οἱ υἱοὶ ὑμῶν καὶ αἱ θυγατέρες ὑμῶν καὶ οἱ νεανίσκοι ὑμῶν ὁράσεις ὄψονται καὶ οἱ πρεσβύτεροι ὑμῶν ἐνυπνίοις ἐνυπνιασθήσονται
verses.transliteration: Kai estai en tais eschatais hēmerais legei ho Theos ekcheō apo tou Pneumatos mou epi pasan sarka kai prophēteusousin hoi huioi hymōn kai hai thygateres hymōn kai hoi neaniskoi hymōn horaseis opsontai kai hoi presbyteroi hymōn enypniois enypniasthēsontai
verses.literal: In the last days - God says I will pour out My Spirit on all people Your sons and - daughters will prophesy your young men will see visions your old men will dream dreams
verses.literalPt: E nos últimos dias acontecerá, diz Deus, Que do meu Espírito derramarei sobre toda a carne; E os vossos filhos e as vossas filhas profetizarão, Os vossos jovens terão visões, E os vossos velhos terão sonhos;

verses.original: καί‿ γε ἐπὶ τοὺς δούλους μου καὶ ἐπὶ τὰς δούλας μου ἐν ταῖς ἡμέραις ἐκείναις ἐκχεῶ ἀπὸ τοῦ Πνεύματός μου καὶ προφητεύσουσιν
verses.transliteration: kai ge epi tous doulous mou kai epi tas doulas mou en tais hēmerais ekeinais ekcheō apo tou Pneumatos mou kai prophēteusousin
verses.literal: Even on My menservants and - maidservants I will pour out . . . My Spirit in those days and they will prophesy
verses.literalPt: E também do meu Espírito derramarei sobre os meus servos e as minhas servas naqueles dias, e profetizarão;

verses.original: καὶ δώσω τέρατα ἐν τῷ οὐρανῷ ἄνω καὶ σημεῖα ἐπὶ τῆς γῆς κάτω αἷμα καὶ πῦρ καὶ ἀτμίδα καπνοῦ
verses.transliteration: kai dōsō terata en tō ouranō anō kai sēmeia epi tēs gēs katō haima kai pyr kai atmida kapnou
verses.literal: I will show wonders in the heavens above and signs on the earth below blood and fire and billows of smoke
verses.literalPt: E farei aparecer prodígios em cima, no céu; E sinais em baixo na terra, Sangue, fogo e vapor de fumo.

verses.original: ὁ ἥλιος μεταστραφήσεται εἰς σκότος καὶ ἡ σελήνη εἰς αἷμα πρὶν ἐλθεῖν ἡμέραν Κυρίου τὴν μεγάλην καὶ ἐπιφανῆ
verses.transliteration: ho hēlios metastraphēsetai eis skotos kai hē selēnē eis haima prin elthein hēmeran Kyriou tēn megalēn kai epiphanē
verses.literal: The sun will be turned to darkness and the moon to blood before the coming of the great and glorious Day of the Lord
verses.literalPt: O sol se converterá em trevas, E a lua em sangue, Antes de chegar o grande e glorioso dia do Senhor;

verses.original: καὶ ἔσται πᾶς ὃς ἐὰν ἐπικαλέσηται τὸ ὄνομα Κυρίου σωθήσεται
verses.transliteration: kai estai pas hos ean epikalesētai to onoma Kyriou sōthēsetai
verses.literal: And everyone who calls on the name of the Lord will be saved
verses.literalPt: E acontecerá que todo aquele que invocar o nome do Senhor será salvo.

verses.original: Ἄνδρες Ἰσραηλῖται ἀκούσατε τοὺς λόγους τούτους Ἰησοῦν τὸν Ναζωραῖον ἄνδρα ἀποδεδειγμένον ἀπὸ τοῦ Θεοῦ εἰς ὑμᾶς δυνάμεσι καὶ τέρασι καὶ σημείοις οἷς ἐποίησεν δι’ αὐτοῦ ὁ Θεὸς ἐν μέσῳ ὑμῶν καθὼς αὐτοὶ οἴδατε
verses.transliteration: Andres Israēlitai akousate tous logous toutous Iēsoun ton Nazōraion andra apodedeigmenon apo tou Theou eis hymas dynamesi kai terasi kai sēmeiois hois epoiēsen di’ autou ho Theos en mesō hymōn kathōs autoi oidate
verses.literal: Men of Israel listen to this message Jesus of Nazareth was a man certified by God to you by miracles wonders and signs which God did among you through Him as you yourselves know
verses.literalPt: Homens israelitas, escutai estas palavras: A Jesus Nazareno, homem aprovado por Deus entre vós com maravilhas, prodígios e sinais, que Deus por ele fez no meio de vós, como vós mesmos bem sabeis;

verses.original: τοῦτον τῇ ὡρισμένῃ βουλῇ καὶ προγνώσει τοῦ Θεοῦ ἔκδοτον διὰ χειρὸς ἀνόμων προσπήξαντες ἀνείλατε
verses.transliteration: touton tē hōrismenē boulē kai prognōsei tou Theou ekdoton dia cheiros anomōn prospēxantes aneilate
verses.literal: He was delivered up by God’s set plan and foreknowledge and you, by the hands of the lawless put Him to death by nailing Him to the cross
verses.literalPt: A este que vos foi entregue pelo determinado conselho e presciência de Deus, prendestes, crucificastes e matastes pelas mãos de injustos;

verses.original: ὃν ὁ Θεὸς ἀνέστησεν λύσας τὰς ὠδῖνας τοῦ θανάτου καθότι οὐκ ἦν δυνατὸν κρατεῖσθαι αὐτὸν ὑπ’ αὐτοῦ
verses.transliteration: hon ho Theos anestēsen lysas tas ōdinas tou thanatou kathoti ouk ēn dynaton krateisthai auton hyp’ autou
verses.literal: But God raised Him from the dead releasing Him from the agony of death because it was impossible for death to keep Him in its grip
verses.literalPt: Ao qual Deus ressuscitou, soltas as ânsias da morte, pois não era possível que fosse retido por ela;

verses.original: Δαυὶδ γὰρ λέγει εἰς αὐτόν Προορώμην τὸν Κύριον ἐνώπιόν μου διὰ παντός ὅτι ἐκ δεξιῶν μού ἐστιν ἵνα μὴ σαλευθῶ
verses.transliteration: Dauid gar legei eis auton Proorōmēn ton Kyrion enōpion mou dia pantos hoti ek dexiōn mou estin hina mē saleuthō
verses.literal: David says about Him I saw the Lord always . . . before me because He is at my right hand I will not be shaken
verses.literalPt: Porque dele disse Davi: Sempre via diante de mim o Senhor, Porque está à minha direita, para que eu não seja comovido;

verses.original: διὰ τοῦτο ηὐφράνθη μου ἡ καρδία καὶ ἠγαλλιάσατο ἡ γλῶσσά μου ἔτι δὲ καὶ ἡ σάρξ μου κατασκηνώσει ἐπ’ ἐλπίδι
verses.transliteration: dia touto ēuphranthē mou hē kardia kai ēgalliasato hē glōssa mou eti de kai hē sarx mou kataskēnōsei ep’ elpidi
verses.literal: Therefore . . . my heart is glad and my tongue rejoices - my body also will dwell in hope
verses.literalPt: Por isso se alegrou o meu coração, e a minha língua exultou; E ainda a minha carne há de repousar em esperança;

verses.original: ὅτι οὐκ ἐνκαταλείψεις τὴν ψυχήν μου εἰς ᾅδην οὐδὲ δώσεις τὸν Ὅσιόν σου ἰδεῖν διαφθοράν
verses.transliteration: hoti ouk enkataleipseis tēn psychēn mou eis hadēn oude dōseis ton Hosion sou idein diaphthoran
verses.literal: because You will not abandon my soul to Hades nor will You let Your Holy One see decay
verses.literalPt: Pois não deixarás a minha alma no inferno, Nem permitirás que o teu Santo veja a corrupção;

verses.original: ἐγνώρισάς μοι ὁδοὺς ζωῆς πληρώσεις με εὐφροσύνης μετὰ τοῦ προσώπου σου
verses.transliteration: egnōrisas moi hodous zōēs plērōseis me euphrosynēs meta tou prosōpou sou
verses.literal: You have made known to me the paths of life You will fill me with joy in Your presence
verses.literalPt: Fizeste-me conhecidos os caminhos da vida; Com a tua face me encherás de júbilo.

verses.original: Ἄνδρες ἀδελφοί ἐξὸν εἰπεῖν μετὰ παρρησίας πρὸς ὑμᾶς περὶ τοῦ πατριάρχου Δαυὶδ ὅτι καὶ ἐτελεύτησεν καὶ ἐτάφη καὶ τὸ μνῆμα αὐτοῦ ἔστιν ἐν ἡμῖν ἄχρι τῆς ἡμέρας ταύτης
verses.transliteration: Andres adelphoi exon eipein meta parrēsias pros hymas peri tou patriarchou Dauid hoti kai eteleutēsen kai etaphē kai to mnēma autou estin en hēmin achri tēs hēmeras tautēs
verses.literal: Brothers I can tell you with confidence that the patriarch David died and was buried and his tomb is with us to this day
verses.literalPt: Homens irmãos, seja-me lícito dizer-vos livremente acerca do patriarca Davi, que ele morreu e foi sepultado, e entre nós está até hoje a sua sepultura.

verses.original: προφήτης οὖν ὑπάρχων καὶ εἰδὼς ὅτι ὅρκῳ ὤμοσεν αὐτῷ ὁ Θεὸς ἐκ καρποῦ τῆς ὀσφύος αὐτοῦ καθίσαι ἐπὶ τὸν θρόνον αὐτοῦ
verses.transliteration: prophētēs oun hyparchōn kai eidōs hoti horkō ōmosen autō ho Theos ek karpou tēs osphyos autou kathisai epi ton thronon autou
verses.literal: But he was a prophet and knew that God had promised him on oath that He would place one of his descendants on his throne
verses.literalPt: Sendo, pois, ele profeta, e sabendo que Deus lhe havia prometido com juramento que do fruto de seus lombos, segundo a carne, levantaria o Cristo, para o assentar sobre o seu trono,

verses.original: προϊδὼν ἐλάλησεν περὶ τῆς ἀναστάσεως τοῦ Χριστοῦ ὅτι οὔτε ἐνκατελείφθη εἰς ᾅδην οὔτε ἡ σὰρξ αὐτοῦ εἶδεν διαφθοράν
verses.transliteration: proidōn elalēsen peri tēs anastaseōs tou Christou hoti oute enkateleiphthē eis hadēn oute hē sarx autou eiden diaphthoran
verses.literal: Foreseeing this David spoke about the resurrection of the Christ that He was not abandoned to Hades nor did His body see decay
verses.literalPt: Nesta previsão, disse da ressurreição de Cristo, que a sua alma não foi deixada no inferno, nem a sua carne viu a corrupção.

verses.original: Τοῦτον τὸν Ἰησοῦν ἀνέστησεν ὁ Θεός οὗ πάντες ἡμεῖς ἐσμεν μάρτυρες
verses.transliteration: Touton ton Iēsoun anestēsen ho Theos hou pantes hēmeis esmen martyres
verses.literal: God has raised this Jesus to life to which we are all witnesses
verses.literalPt: Deus ressuscitou a este Jesus, do que todos nós somos testemunhas.

verses.original: τῇ δεξιᾷ οὖν τοῦ Θεοῦ ὑψωθεὶς τήν τε ἐπαγγελίαν τοῦ Πνεύματος τοῦ Ἁγίου λαβὼν παρὰ τοῦ Πατρὸς ἐξέχεεν τοῦτο ὃ ὑμεῖς καὶ βλέπετε καὶ ἀκούετε
verses.transliteration: tē dexia oun tou Theou hypsōtheis tēn te epangelian tou Pneumatos tou Hagiou labōn para tou Patros execheen touto ho hymeis kai blepete kai akouete
verses.literal: Exalted then to the right hand of God He has received from the Father the promised - Holy Spirit and has poured out what you now see and hear
verses.literalPt: De sorte que, exaltado pela destra de Deus, e tendo recebido do Pai a promessa do Espírito Santo, derramou isto que vós agora vedes e ouvis.

verses.original: Οὐ γὰρ Δαυὶδ ἀνέβη εἰς τοὺς οὐρανούς λέγει δὲ αὐτός Εἶπεν ὁ Κύριος τῷ Κυρίῳ μου Κάθου ἐκ δεξιῶν μου
verses.transliteration: Ou gar Dauid anebē eis tous ouranous legei de autos Eipen ho Kyrios tō Kyriō mou Kathou ek dexiōn mou
verses.literal: For David did not ascend into heaven but he himself says The Lord said to my Lord Sit at My right hand
verses.literalPt: Porque Davi não subiu aos céus, mas ele próprio diz: Disse o SENHOR ao meu Senhor: Assenta-te à minha direita,

verses.original: ἕως ἂν θῶ τοὺς ἐχθρούς σου ὑποπόδιον τῶν ποδῶν σου
verses.transliteration: heōs an thō tous echthrous sou hypopodion tōn podōn sou
verses.literal: until . . . I make Your enemies a footstool for Your feet
verses.literalPt: Até que ponha os teus inimigos por escabelo de teus pés.

verses.original: Ἀσφαλῶς οὖν γινωσκέτω πᾶς οἶκος Ἰσραὴλ ὅτι καὶ Κύριον αὐτὸν καὶ Χριστὸν ἐποίησεν ὁ Θεός τοῦτον τὸν Ἰησοῦν ὃν ὑμεῖς ἐσταυρώσατε
verses.transliteration: Asphalōs oun ginōsketō pas oikos Israēl hoti kai Kyrion auton kai Christon epoiēsen ho Theos touton ton Iēsoun hon hymeis estaurōsate
verses.literal: Therefore let all Israel know with certainty that God has made this Jesus whom you crucified both Lord and Christ
verses.literalPt: Saiba, pois, com certeza toda a casa de Israel que a esse Jesus, a quem vós crucificastes, Deus o fez Senhor e Cristo.

verses.original: Ἀκούσαντες δὲ κατενύγησαν τὴν καρδίαν εἶπόν τε πρὸς τὸν Πέτρον καὶ τοὺς λοιποὺς ἀποστόλους Τί ποιήσωμεν ἄνδρες ἀδελφοί
verses.transliteration: Akousantes de katenygēsan tēn kardian eipon te pros ton Petron kai tous loipous apostolous Ti poiēsōmen andres adelphoi
verses.literal: When the people heard this they were cut to the heart and asked . . . Peter and the other apostles Brothers what shall we do
verses.literalPt: E, ouvindo eles isto, compungiram-se em seu coração, e perguntaram a Pedro e aos demais apóstolos: Que faremos, homens irmãos?

verses.original: Πέτρος δὲ πρὸς αὐτούς Μετανοήσατε φησίν Καὶ βαπτισθήτω ἕκαστος ὑμῶν ἐπὶ τῷ ὀνόματι Ἰησοῦ Χριστοῦ εἰς ἄφεσιν τῶν ἁμαρτιῶν ὑμῶν καὶ λήμψεσθε τὴν δωρεὰν τοῦ Ἁγίου Πνεύματος
verses.transliteration: Petros de pros autous Metanoēsate phēsin Kai baptisthētō hekastos hymōn epi tō onomati Iēsou Christou eis aphesin tōn hamartiōn hymōn kai lēmpsesthe tēn dōrean tou Hagiou Pneumatos
verses.literal: Peter replied - Repent and be baptized every one of you in the name of Jesus Christ for the forgiveness of your sins and you will receive the gift of the Holy Spirit
verses.literalPt: E disse-lhes Pedro: Arrependei-vos, e cada um de vós seja batizado em nome de Jesus Cristo, para perdão dos pecados; e recebereis o dom do Espírito Santo;

verses.original: ὑμῖν γάρ ἐστιν ἡ ἐπαγγελία καὶ τοῖς τέκνοις ὑμῶν καὶ πᾶσιν τοῖς εἰς μακρὰν ὅσους ἂν προσκαλέσηται Κύριος ὁ Θεὸς ἡμῶν
verses.transliteration: hymin gar estin hē epangelia kai tois teknois hymōn kai pasin tois eis makran hosous an proskalesētai Kyrios ho Theos hēmōn
verses.literal: This promise belongs to you and your children and to all who are . . . far off to all whom . . . the Lord our God will call to Himself
verses.literalPt: Porque a promessa vos diz respeito a vós, a vossos filhos, e a todos os que estão longe, a tantos quantos Deus nosso Senhor chamar.

verses.original: Ἑτέροις τε λόγοις πλείοσιν διεμαρτύρατο καὶ παρεκάλει αὐτοὺς λέγων Σώθητε ἀπὸ τῆς γενεᾶς τῆς σκολιᾶς ταύτης
verses.transliteration: Heterois te logois pleiosin diemartyrato kai parekalei autous legōn Sōthēte apo tēs geneas tēs skolias tautēs
verses.literal: With many other words he testified and he urged them Be saved from this corrupt generation
verses.literalPt: E com muitas outras palavras isto testificava, e os exortava, dizendo: Salvai-vos desta geração perversa.

verses.original: οἱ μὲν οὖν ἀποδεξάμενοι τὸν λόγον αὐτοῦ ἐβαπτίσθησαν καὶ προσετέθησαν ἐν τῇ ἡμέρᾳ ἐκείνῃ ψυχαὶ ὡσεὶ τρισχίλιαι
verses.transliteration: hoi men oun apodexamenoi ton logon autou ebaptisthēsan kai prosetethēsan en tē hēmera ekeinē psychai hōsei trischiliai
verses.literal: Those who embraced his message were baptized and about three thousand . . . were added to the believers that day
verses.literalPt: De sorte que foram batizados os que de bom grado receberam a sua palavra; e naquele dia agregaram-se quase três mil almas,

verses.original: Ἦσαν δὲ προσκαρτεροῦντες τῇ διδαχῇ τῶν ἀποστόλων καὶ τῇ κοινωνίᾳ τῇ κλάσει τοῦ ἄρτου καὶ ταῖς προσευχαῖς
verses.transliteration: Ēsan de proskarterountes tē didachē tōn apostolōn kai tē koinōnia tē klasei tou artou kai tais proseuchais
verses.literal: They devoted themselves to the apostles’ teaching and to the fellowship to the breaking of bread and to prayer
verses.literalPt: E perseveravam na doutrina dos apóstolos, e na comunhão, e no partir do pão, e nas orações.

verses.original: Ἐγίνετο δὲ πάσῃ ψυχῇ φόβος πολλά τε τέρατα καὶ σημεῖα διὰ τῶν ἀποστόλων ἐγίνετο
verses.transliteration: Egineto de pasē psychē phobos polla te terata kai sēmeia dia tōn apostolōn egineto
verses.literal: A sense of awe came over everyone . . . and the apostles performed . . . many wonders and signs
verses.literalPt: E em toda a alma havia temor, e muitas maravilhas e sinais se faziam pelos apóstolos.

verses.original: Πάντες δὲ οἱ πιστεύοντες ἦσαν ἐπὶ τὸ αὐτὸ καὶ εἶχον ἅπαντα κοινά
verses.transliteration: Pantes de hoi pisteuontes ēsan epi to auto kai eichon hapanta koina
verses.literal: All the believers were together . . . . . . and had everything in common
verses.literalPt: E todos os que criam estavam juntos, e tinham tudo em comum.

verses.original: καὶ τὰ κτήματα καὶ τὰς ὑπάρξεις ἐπίπρασκον καὶ διεμέριζον αὐτὰ πᾶσιν καθότι ἄν τις χρείαν εἶχεν
verses.transliteration: kai ta ktēmata kai tas hyparxeis epipraskon kai diemerizon auta pasin kathoti an tis chreian eichen
verses.literal: Selling their possessions and goods they shared with . . . . . . . . . . . . anyone who was in need
verses.literalPt: E vendiam suas propriedades e bens, e repartiam com todos, segundo cada um havia de mister.

verses.original: Καθ’ ἡμέραν τε προσκαρτεροῦντες ὁμοθυμαδὸν ἐν τῷ ἱερῷ κλῶντές τε κατ’ οἶκον ἄρτον μετελάμβανον τροφῆς ἐν ἀγαλλιάσει καὶ ἀφελότητι καρδίας
verses.transliteration: Kath’ hēmeran te proskarterountes homothymadon en tō hierō klōntes te kat’ oikon arton metelambanon trophēs en agalliasei kai aphelotēti kardias
verses.literal: With one accord they continued to meet daily in the temple courts and to break bread from house to house sharing their meals with gladness and sincerity of heart
verses.literalPt: E, perseverando unânimes todos os dias no templo, e partindo o pão em casa, comiam juntos com alegria e singeleza de coração,

verses.original: αἰνοῦντες τὸν Θεὸν καὶ ἔχοντες χάριν πρὸς ὅλον τὸν λαόν ὁ δὲ Κύριος προσετίθει τοὺς σῳζομένους καθ’ ἡμέραν ἐπὶ τὸ αὐτό
verses.transliteration: ainountes ton Theon kai echontes charin pros holon ton laon ho de Kyrios prosetithei tous sōzomenous kath’ hēmeran epi to auto
verses.literal: praising God and enjoying the favor of all the people And the Lord added to their number daily those who were being saved
verses.literalPt: Louvando a Deus, e caindo na graça de todo o povo. E todos os dias acrescentava o Senhor à igreja aqueles que se haviam de salvar.
